name: THE AQUARIUM
rule: VAMILY rules 416 (the big interiors: the tile stays a house), 461 (more boards), 451(a) (its ceiling at 10%), 59 (every tile its cost and its effect), 428, 441.
facts: The Strip's aquarium, in a resort on the south Strip, is a walk through dark halls between tanks; its biggest tank holds over a million gallons with a glass tunnel through it.
An aquarium without power: the pumps and filters stop, the water goes green, and what lived in it dies; the glass holds.
On house tiles a tank is a tile nobody can cross that you still see through; its glass stops a shot the way cover does.
how_to_mod: A layout is 15 strings of 20 characters; every character is in 'legend'; every tile kind a legend entry names has its row in 'tiles' (its cost and its effect). A piece names the finished piece it is drawn as ('like') until this folder has its own art file (aquarium_art.json: floor lists and a kit, the garage's format). slices/bohemia_big_inside.js lays it; slices/fight_ground/insides.json lists the insides.
districts_why: The aquarium is its own map kind on the Strip, a building of dark halls: eight fights in ten there are fought inside it, by the cell's own dice; the rest at its doors and the resort's drive.
share_dice: THE MAP'S DICE (COMBAT FOUR 11/22): a place's inside is rolled from its cell (the same cell the same answer), so a place on a few cells goes inside on a step, never a slope: 'share' is the threshold its real cells need for 'share_meant' to come true over a whole run of valleys, measured on the map's own cells (gates/the_big_insides_gate.js I14). aquarium: meant 0.8, went inside in 40% of its cells over 40 valleys (6 places, 40 cells, after what the parking garage takes first); at 0.89, 93%, the nearest its dice allow.
tiles_how: Rule 59: every kind of tile says what it costs to step on and what it does. 'row' is the fight's own ground row (flat 2 AP, rough 3, swamp 4 and worse at fighting, height +1 a level, obstacles none); 'open' is open floor (on AUTO nobody stays on it); 'good' is ground AUTO goes to; 'say' is the one line he reads when he taps it (draft, the fewest words). [bb] each kind is a Battle Brothers ground: flat, rough, swamp, an obstacle, and cover as its trees and walls give it.

wall.effect: The building's wall, painted black: no way through, no sight through.

floor.effect: The dark carpet of the halls: open ground, nothing to hide behind; on AUTO nobody stays on it.

tank.effect: A tank, its water gone green and still: nobody passes, but you see through the glass, and it stops a shot like cover. [bb] its wall you can see over.

column.effect: A jellyfish column, floor to ceiling, empty: nobody passes; you see through it; cover beside it. [bb] its boulder.

pool.effect: The touch pool, knee deep and slick: slow going (4 AP), and a man standing in it fights worse. [bb] its swamp.
pool.say: The touch pool: slow going, and you fight worse in it.

tunnel.effect: The glass tunnel through the big tank, its moving walkway dead: the tank all round you, its rail low cover.

leak.effect: Where the tunnel's seam gave, the tank leaks in, knee deep: slow going (4 AP), and a man in it fights worse. [bb] its swamp.
leak.say: The leak: slow going, and you fight worse in it.

benches.effect: Viewing benches facing the glass: low cover.

kiosk.effect: A dead info kiosk: low cover.

rockwork.effect: The themed rockwork round the tanks, fake stone over steel: cover, and a climb to cross (3 AP). [bb] its rocks.

panel.effect: A tank's acrylic panel, fallen and propped: cover.

fire.effect: A fire somebody keeps in a trash can. It burns day and night: a man in its light is seen.
fire.say_lit: A fire: you stand in its light, and they see you.

doors.effect: The doors out to the resort, open: open ground, and by day the light falls in: a man here is seen.
doors.say_lit: The doors: open ground, and the day is on you.

kit_how: Every piece is drawn AS a finished piece of another kit ('like') until COOK's own picture for it is in aquarium_art.json under the same name: then that picture is used and nothing here changes. 'kind' is what it does in the fight (COVER, LOW_COVER, WALL); 'blocks_move' means nobody stands on its tile.
start_why: NO HIGH GROUND: the halls are one floor; the rockwork is a climb across, not a place above.

ceiling.how: VAMILY rule 451(a): the halls' black ceiling, its ducts and dead spotlights, over the board at this alpha. 'src' is the picture COOK makes; 'have' true the day it is in the folder. Until then the fight draws 'kind' itself, a stand-in (the garage's deck).
